title: Description of the Reality of Creation Through the Tree Parable

questions.question: What is the main comparison made at the beginning of the marked passage?
questions.answer: It compares a hidden, enormous tree with the whole created order and uses that comparison to explain how the Qur’an describes creation.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there must be order and balance between a tree and its parts?
questions.answer: Because every branch, leaf, flower, and fruit belongs to one living whole, so each part takes its shape in a way that fits the nature of the tree.

questions.question: What would prove that an artist truly knows the unseen tree behind the veil?
questions.answer: If the artist could correctly map all its parts, keep the right proportions between them, and show how they connect from beginning to end, that would show real knowledge of the hidden tree.

questions.question: In the comparison, what does the hidden tree stand for?
questions.answer: It stands for the reality of creation and all contingent beings.

questions.question: How wide is the created order described as being?
questions.answer: It is described as stretching from the start of the world to the hereafter, from the earth to the divine throne, and from tiny particles to the sun.

questions.question: According to the passage, how have scholars reacted to the Qur’an’s description of creation?
questions.answer: They have expressed amazement and praised Allah, saying that the Qur’an explains the universe with great wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by calling the universe a riddle or sealed mystery?
questions.answer: It means the universe is difficult to understand on its own, and the Qur’an explains its meaning and order.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Qur’an’s presentation of these truths?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an presents them in a fully harmonious, fitting, and consistent way.

questions.question: What response do people of insight give when they recognize this harmony?
questions.answer: They glorify Allah and confirm that the Qur’an’s description matches reality with excellence.

questions.question: What picture does the passage ask the reader to imagine first?
questions.answer: A huge and extraordinary tree hidden behind a covering so that it cannot be seen directly.

questions.question: Why is the tree described as hidden from sight?
questions.answer: To prepare the reader for the idea that something unseen can still be known truly by its accurate description.

questions.question: What relationship is said to exist among all parts of a tree?
questions.answer: They are all connected through fitting measure, unity, and mutual correspondence.

questions.question: If someone accurately drew the hidden tree without seeing it openly, what would that show?
questions.answer: It would show that the person has knowledge that reaches beyond ordinary sight.

questions.question: What lesson is taken from this example before applying it to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: A complete and accurate description of something hidden points to deep and comprehensive knowledge of it.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Qur’an describes with such precision?
questions.answer: It describes the true nature of created beings and the overall structure of creation.

questions.question: How far does this created order extend in the passage’s description?
questions.answer: Across time, space, and scale, from the world’s beginning to the hereafter and from the smallest things to heavenly bodies.

questions.question: What feature of the Qur’an’s description especially impresses scholars?
questions.answer: The exact proportion and suitability it preserves between all parts of reality.

questions.question: What conclusion have careful scholars reached after studying these descriptions?
questions.answer: They conclude that the Qur’an reveals astonishing wisdom and unlocks the meaning of the universe.

questions.question: Why is the Qur’an called able to solve the universe’s mystery in this passage?
questions.answer: Because it explains how different parts of existence fit together under divine wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way these truths are presented in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They are presented so well together that none of them conflict with or weaken the others.

questions.question: How do wise people respond to this kind of presentation?
questions.answer: They praise Allah and affirm that the Qur’an’s account is true and fitting.

questions.question: What kind of object is used as a symbol for understanding the rest of the marked passage?
questions.answer: A hidden tree with many connected parts.

questions.question: Why is a tree a fitting symbol in this passage?
questions.answer: Because a tree has many parts that depend on one another and form one organized whole.

questions.question: What would make a drawing of the hidden tree convincing?
questions.answer: The drawing would need to show each part in the right place, shape, and proportion from one end of the tree to the other.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the person who could make such a drawing?
questions.answer: That person would have penetrating knowledge of what is hidden.

questions.question: How is this example transferred to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The passage says the Qur’an describes all created reality with the same kind of perfect precision and correspondence.

questions.question: What does “contingent beings” mean in the passage?
questions.answer: It means created things that do not exist on their own and depend on Allah.

questions.question: What does the broad range from particles to the sun emphasize?
questions.answer: It emphasizes the Qur’an’s ability to address every level of existence, from the smallest to the greatest.

questions.question: What does the broad range from the world’s beginning to the hereafter emphasize?
questions.answer: It emphasizes that the Qur’an’s knowledge covers all stages of existence across time.

questions.question: Why do scholars praise Allah after examining the Qur’an’s depictions?
questions.answer: Because they see that its descriptions are full of wisdom, accuracy, and beauty.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Qur’an do for the universe’s mystery?
questions.answer: It opens and explains it.

questions.question: What is remarkable about the Qur’an’s explanation of these matters?
questions.answer: It joins them together in a way that is balanced, suitable, and free of contradiction.

questions.question: Who is said to recognize the truth of this presentation most clearly?
questions.answer: People of wisdom, insight, and deep reflection.

questions.question: What central idea is taught through the example of the unseen tree?
questions.answer: A hidden reality can be known by a description that preserves all its parts in perfect order.

questions.question: What details of the tree must match for the picture to be believable?
questions.answer: Its branches, fruits, leaves, blossoms, and their overall proportions must all fit together properly.

questions.question: Why would a correct picture of the unseen tree remove doubt?
questions.answer: Because such accuracy would be impossible without true knowledge of what lies behind the veil.

questions.question: In the passage, what is being “pictured” in a similar way to the hidden tree?
questions.answer: The whole structure and reality of creation.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the scope of creation?
questions.answer: As reaching across the world, the hereafter, the earth, the highest levels above, and everything from the tiniest matter to the sun.

questions.question: What does the passage say investigative scholars discovered in the Qur’an’s descriptions?
questions.answer: They found a stunning level of fittingness, measure, and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the relationship among the truths the Qur’an presents?
questions.answer: They support one another and remain in harmony without conflict.

questions.question: How do those with deep understanding respond to this harmony?
questions.answer: They glorify Allah and affirm that the Qur’an’s presentation is fully true and beautiful.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an’s treatment of even distant results and subtle details?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an includes them in a way that still preserves harmony.

questions.question: What human explanation for the Qur’an does the passage reject?
questions.answer: It rejects the idea that it came from limited human knowledge.

questions.question: What positive explanation does the passage give instead?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an comes from all-encompassing divine knowledge.

questions.question: What overall message about the Qur’an is the marked passage trying to leave with the reader?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an’s perfect harmony and far-reaching knowledge prove its divine source.

questions.question: What does the passage ask us to imagine before discussing the Qur’an directly?
questions.answer: It asks us to imagine a huge hidden tree whose full form is covered from sight.

questions.question: According to the passage, why must the parts of that tree match one another?
questions.answer: Because each part belongs to the same reality and should reflect the character of the whole.

questions.question: What would be impressive about someone drawing that tree correctly on top of the veil?
questions.answer: The person would be showing exact knowledge of something not directly visible.

questions.question: What does this example help us understand about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that the Qur’an describes unseen and vast realities with precise truth.

questions.question: What “tree” does the passage say the Qur’an describes?
questions.answer: The tree of creation, meaning the entire order of created existence.

questions.question: What signs of accuracy are emphasized in the Qur’an’s description of creation?
questions.answer: Proper proportion, suitable form, and harmony among all parts.

questions.question: How have serious scholars responded after examining this?
questions.answer: They have reacted with wonder and praise, recognizing extraordinary wisdom in it.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest the Qur’an can do that others cannot?
questions.answer: It can explain the hidden meaning and structure of the universe.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Qur’an’s method of presenting all these truths?
questions.answer: It presents them in a way that is mutually fitting, balanced, and never conflicting.

questions.question: What kind of people especially confirm this truth?
questions.answer: Those who have insight into realities and deeper wisdom.

questions.question: What does the final Qur’anic verse in the marked passage support?
questions.answer: It supports the claim that the Book is completely sound and without deviation.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the opening example about a concealed tree?
questions.answer: It is meant to show how accurate description can prove true knowledge of something hidden.

questions.question: Which qualities of the tree are especially important in the example?
questions.answer: The connectedness, measure, and agreement among all its parts.

questions.question: What would show that the artist’s knowledge goes beyond guessing?
questions.answer: The artist would correctly present every part in proper relation to the whole.

questions.question: How is this linked to the Qur’an in the next paragraph?
questions.answer: The passage says the Qur’an does the same with the whole of created reality.

questions.question: What does the phrase about contingent beings point to in simple terms?
questions.answer: It points to all created things that exist by Allah’s will.

questions.question: What ranges of existence are brought together to show the Qur’an’s broad vision?
questions.answer: Time, place, and size are all covered, from the first stage of the world to the hereafter and from tiny particles to the sun.

questions.question: What effect has this had on scholars who studied deeply?
questions.answer: It led them to admiration, gratitude to Allah, and recognition of the Qur’an’s unmatched wisdom.

questions.question: What makes the Qur’an’s explanation of these realities so impressive according to the passage?
questions.answer: It keeps all truths in harmony so that none are out of place or in conflict.

questions.question: How do wise and spiritually perceptive people answer this harmony?
questions.answer: They glorify Allah and testify that the Qur’an’s words are true and exact.

questions.question: What source for the Qur’an is denied, and what source is affirmed?
questions.answer: Limited human knowledge is denied, and complete divine knowledge is affirmed.

questions.question: What final truth is reinforced by the verse about the Book containing no crookedness?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an is perfectly straight, reliable, and free from inconsistency.
